papers.title: Self-Evolution Should Not Depend on How Skills Are Split: An Exact Certificate for Skill-Taxonomy Representation Invariance

N1.object: Released skill controllers can assign different semantic control solely because equivalent implementation content is represented by different package identities; in one bounded frozen AutoSkill substrate, that representation change propagates to executed behavior.
N1.forbidden: bounded AutoSkill P19 behavior consequence only; no task utility, longitudinal regret, or general AutoSkill safety claim

N2.object: Exact-refinement STRI is equivalent to quotient factorization of semantic-class mass; R*(A;q) exactly decides target realizability by package-first mass, while a semantic-first row-stochastic implementation factorization realizes any covered target after changing the action basis.

N3.object: STRI has two separable boundaries: identity-local normalization violates exact-refinement invariance, while after quotienting the neutral residual is not determined by overlap count alone and is exactly characterized by target realizability in the package support cone.
N3.forbidden: do not generalize equalizability beyond audited support matrices

papers.paper_quality_interpretation: Manuscript QA and venue-format QA remain valid mechanical checks, but they cannot establish top-tier scientific completeness. The frozen-data evidence suite now includes exact support-edit radii, degree-preserving structural controls, target-ray and package-mass sensitivity, sparse-witness redundancy, taxonomy perturbation, ruling-out, failure, and finite-snapshot uncertainty analyses; Paper Quality v2.1 passes only when the manuscript itself consumes those artifacts and binds reviewer-question-driven visualizations to versioned data, scripts, figures, and captions.
papers.cheap_first: Prefer CPU/released-artifact taxonomy perturbation, reduction ablations, uncertainty, and sensitivity before reopening any dynamic GPU lane.
papers.next_action: Human authors review and accept responsibility for the final manuscript and AI-use disclosure, freeze the complete author list before the ICLR abstract deadline, complete the OpenReview signoff checklist, then submit the genuine abstract by 2026-09-18 AoE and the paper plus anonymous supplement by 2026-09-25 AoE. Do not reopen dynamic P0 or broaden N1-N3 unless independently qualified new evidence appears.

claim_boundary.dynamic_p0: Qwen3 qualification failure is excluded from narrow evidence; the separate SkillRL P0-E fixed-policy bridge is a qualified C4 realization STOP only

autoskill_p19.claim_boundary: Single archived P19 behavioral-harm substrate. Supports a representation-to-retrieval-to-executed-behavior consequence under the frozen AutoSkill top-k operationalization; does not establish task-utility effects, general AutoSkill safety, or automatic full-paper authority.

mediator_isolation.claim_boundary: Specific mediator attribution on one archived P19 substrate only. This strengthens the representation-to-retrieval-to-executed-behavior chain but does not establish task utility, longitudinal regret, end-to-end AutoSkill behavior, or general AutoSkill safety.

claim_boundary.downstream_utility: AutoSkill P19 supports one bounded executed-behavior consequence; task utility, longitudinal regret, and general AutoSkill safety are not claimed, and the SkillRL endpoint STOP is not a population-level no-effect theorem
claim_boundary.solver_novelty: STRI-Cert is not claimed as a computationally novel LP solver
claim_boundary.repair_method: no claim that Support-Quotient Control has been empirically validated

papers.title: Temporal Safety Conclusions Are Evaluator-Relative: A Controlled Audit of Persistent Web Agents
papers.central_question: When a persistent agent is evaluated over time, are the current-pass premise, future first-violation sets, and matched intervention ordering stable across independently frozen evaluators?

primary_next_action.action: Wait for or acquire the named external support asset, then rerun the same frozen internal readiness checks.
primary_next_action.action_zh: 等待或取得已命名的外部支持资产，再按同一冻结规则重跑内部就绪检查。

limitations: ERTA was derived after O5/O6 revealed evaluator disagreement, then prospectively applied once on 12 fresh held-out episodes; that application validates fail-closed operation on one panel, not broad generalization.
The study has two automated evaluators, one Qwen3-8B backbone, four historical persistent states, 12 historical branches per arm, and horizon H=3.
DeepSeek is an independent semantic co-evaluator, not a human oracle; the prepared human packet remains unlabeled.
The 24-item calibration panel is deterministically stratified by hidden HarmBench label and is not prevalence representative.

Fresh-backbone and longer-horizon replication was prospectively gated but stopped at the support layer before any fresh-backbone safety output because available non-Qwen backbones could not satisfy the frozen browser-action interface.
reopen_conditions: Prospectively freeze and execute blinded human or otherwise independently validated semantic labels for the same trajectory panel without changing the existing evaluator outputs.
Standardize a fresh-backbone action interface before any safety outcome, then prospectively replicate ERTA with a dual-evaluator current-pass gate and a frozen longer horizon.
For mechanism attribution, prospectively design task-semantic controls for behavior IDs 21 and 33 rather than selecting explanations from current disagreements.

papers.title: Reward Errors Become Persistent State: A Controlled Write-Time Memory Intervention in Self-Improving Agents
papers.central_question: Can an erroneous reward label become persistent agent state by changing the memory written from an otherwise identical trajectory, and does that perturbation reach later behavior?

primary_next_action.action: No additional autonomous research, experiment, or paper-repair action is required by the internal Research OS.
primary_next_action.action_zh: 内部 Research OS 已无新增科研、实验或论文修复动作；保持冻结证据与主张边界即可。

limitations: The F0 intervention requests six paired memories. Four pairs return complete outputs in both reward conditions. Two failure-label provider responses terminate as incomplete before assistant text is produced. Their provider response identifiers are archived and GET-only recovery confirms that no text is available. These two cases remain support debt. They do not change the observed 4/4 content-divergence result among complete pairs.

F0 establishes the reward-to-memory write channel. It does not yet measure the full reward-to-future-outcome effect. Matched future-task injection and run-level corruption experiments remain experiment debt. The manuscript therefore treats downstream variance amplification as an active causal hypothesis grounded by the observed write-channel mechanism.

The paired intervention uses DeepSeek-V4-Flash as the memory writer. The released ReasoningBank implementation can use other writer models. Replication across memory-writer families remains experiment debt for a model-independent effect-size claim.

The released trajectories used for F0 come from one WebArena Shopping run. They include both original-success and original-failure episodes, which supports the mechanism across outcome strata. Broader task-family replication remains experiment debt.

Token-set Jaccard distance measures content divergence at a coarse lexical level. Title-set changes supply an additional structural measure. A semantic representation analysis can further quantify whether reward labels move memories toward distinct strategy clusters.
Support debt: Two requested F0 failure-label responses remain provider-incomplete after GET-only recovery and are excluded from scientific counts.

papers.title: Do Temporal Skills Really Repair Agents? An Intervention Audit of Repair and Attribution
papers.central_question: When does an apparent reusable temporal-skill effect represent net repair, surface perturbation, or an integration-surface effect under matched evidence?

primary_next_action.action: No additional autonomous research, experiment, or paper-repair action is required by the internal Research OS.
primary_next_action.action_zh: 内部 Research OS 已无新增科研、实验或论文修复动作；保持冻结证据与主张边界即可。

limitations: The TimeSage-EV evaluated snapshot remains unavailable; the source-native replay is independent mechanistic evidence, not an exact rerun.
DeepSeek grounding has five endpoints per cell; Kimi alignment has three endpoints and Kimi grounding two, so small cells are directional/descriptive rather than high-resolution.
G0 is a same-surface placebo, not a universally neutral control; full-track equivalence does not transport to every stratum.
EIA is a post-hoc compatibility probe selected for a dated-release structure compatible with the cutoff mechanism.
R_surf is a forced-one-answer exact-output surface check; its passing +/-10-point portfolio TOST has low observed-variance sensitivity and does not resolve the strictly non-ceiling subset.
Adaptive multi-turn callable interfaces and independently designed temporal retrievers are outside the experiment.
reopen_conditions: Treat a future first-party TimeSage-EV evaluated snapshot as an external replication target.
Reopen broader integration-surface claims only with prospectively powered non-ceiling endpoints or an adaptive multi-turn interface test.
Reopen temporal-retrieval equivalence only with an independently implemented retriever/reranker receiving the same raw candidate evidence.

papers.title: Does Memory Provenance Matter? Matched Success–Failure Swaps Leave the Causal Sign Unresolved
papers.central_question: Does failure-derived trajectory provenance causally sustain future error when future task difficulty and actionable memory guidance are matched?

primary_next_action.action: No additional autonomous research, experiment, or paper-repair action is required by the internal Research OS.
primary_next_action.action_zh: 内部 Research OS 已无新增科研、实验或论文修复动作；保持冻结证据与主张边界即可。

limitations: The current public financial-agent release provides aggregate provenance counts and transition statistics. The matched provenance swap requires the first-party per-query memory artifacts or a faithful reconstruction of the audited ReasoningBank runs. Those artifacts are announced for release upon publication and are currently experiment debt.

The reported provenance accuracies are rounded to three decimals. The integer correct counts used in our decomposition are the unique counts consistent with the reported support sizes and rounded accuracies. The transition allocation beyond the ten W$\rightarrow$W cases is therefore a derived arithmetic decomposition from public aggregate statistics.

Semantic matching between failure-derived memory and success-derived memory is an experimental design challenge. A pair can preserve procedural content while differing in wording. We therefore require an information-equivalence audit before the swap. Pair construction and verifier agreement remain experiment debt until the first-party memory artifacts are available.

The causal claim concerns future persistence under matched memory information. The existing audit supports the provenance-conditioned association and identifies task difficulty as a confound. Direct causal effect size remains experiment debt for the swap experiment in Section~\ref{sec:intervention}.
The empirical source is a financial AgentDojo setting with ReasoningBank. Replication in web agents and other external-memory architectures remains experiment debt for a broader cross-domain claim.
